summary: Recovery requests of esv::status::recovery::RecoverySystem (written in CheckStatusRequests, CheckSourceChange, ProcessStatusChanges, Update). Lives from level load.

fields.name: StatusId
fields.evidence: RecoverySystem::CheckStatusRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x94BF00) builds requests from the status ID of the status request (+8 of the request), compares *element with it when searching (stride 0xC).

fields.name: StackId
fields.evidence: Same function stores the prototype's StackId (GetFixedStringValue(strStackId)).

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2C848C0 zeroes pointer/capacity/size. macOS has ls::DynamicArray<esv::status::recovery::RecoveryRequest>::Reallocate; the Toolkit's RecoveryRequest is 12 bytes (stride 0xC in CheckStatusRequests). Live: 3 allocated arrays, capacity up to 4, size 0.

open_questions: Element type taken from the RecoverySystem's own request list; not proven that the component array uses exactly this struct.
raw_check: 6 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
